summary: JTA characterizes David Jolly (Democrat, FL) as a 'pro-Israel candidate' for governor after he won the Democratic primary to replace DeSantis.
quote: Sunshine State voters will need to choose between two pro-Israel candidates for governor in November's general election to replace Gov. Ron DeSantis, after Republican Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly won their respective primaries

summary: Jolly is characterized as pro-Israel, same as his opponent Donalds, in the Florida governor race context.
quote: Both candidates are pro-Israel but have differed on Trump's actions against Iran.
